nodes.label: User Design Authority
nodes.rationale: The user owns ALL game design, always; every agent only advises and records the user's decisions — none invents game rules, logic, numbers or flow. Directive history is kept in CLAUDE.md, newest wins.

nodes.label: Weight/Value Two-Axis Card Stats
nodes.rationale: Design intent: separating the two numbers creates a wide card pool — e.g. weight 3 / value 20 enhanced cards, cards that add weight in exchange for effects, cards that sacrifice their value to lighten the whole hand.

nodes.label: Golden Chip (×1.5 damage multiplier each)
nodes.rationale: Base maximum 6 chips (4 singles + 2 combo bonuses); ace/picture effects can add more with no cap, but infinite same-turn chip loops are forbidden (F8). Chips reset on every stand (user, 2026-06-11) so chip engines must re-earn each stand.

nodes.label: Effective Weight Ruling (Q22)
nodes.rationale: User ruling 2026-06-11 (Q22 resolved): -jack conditions are judged on a single criterion, effective weight == max weight — non-bust = total hand weight, bust = the center (3rd slot) card's weight. Bust collapses a hand to its center slot, so from that moment the hand's weight IS the center card's weight; the criterion was never 'bust or not'. A weight-21 card in slot 3 of a bust hand is still redjack, and two such hands make closejack. red/blue guys remain impossible on a bust hand. This ruling is the foundation of the WRECK archetype.

nodes.label: Damage Formula (Red value × Blue value × 1.5^chips)
nodes.rationale: Multiplicative — 100×3 loses to 40×20, so any set buffing only one hand is a trap; every set needs the other hand playable. Decimals floored only at the very end. Sign rule (user, 2026-06-11): exactly one negative hand → damage 0; both negative → positive product counts (intended exotic NEGATIVE build).

nodes.label: Damage Pipeline v2 (D0–D9 + direct-damage & incoming channels)
nodes.rationale: User-confirmed 2026-06-11. Separates the activation layer (Red left→right → Blue left→right → aces top→bottom) from the application layer D0 effective cards → D1 per-card mods → D2 hand sum → D3 hand add → D4 hand multiply → D5 sign check → D6 chips → D7 chip multiplier → D8 product → D9 floor & apply. Every effect must declare its stage. Direct damage (E17) bypasses the pipeline; overkill evaporates.
nodes.norm_label: damage pipeline v2 (d0–d9 + direct-damage & incoming channels)

nodes.label: Ace Archetypes (26: EXACT, FULL, WRECK, LACE, NEGATIVE, CHIP, ...)
nodes.rationale: Aces are not generic stat sticks — every ace declares 1–2 archetype tags (deckbuilding directions derived directly from confirmed rules); tagless aces are forbidden. Expanded 13 → 25 (user: 'increase the archetypes') → 26 with LACE. Tension pairs (EXACT↔HEAVY↔WRECK, PICTURE↔PLAIN, etc.) are the source of build diversity.
nodes.norm_label: ace archetypes (26: exact, full, wreck, lace, negative, chip, ...)

nodes.label: WRECK Archetype (deliberate bust)
nodes.rationale: Bust on purpose and recover with a giant card in slot 3 — viable only because the effective-weight ruling lets a bust hand still score redjack/bluejack.

nodes.label: Ace Group / 군 (synergy group, hidden label)
nodes.rationale: Groups (3–5 aces, archetype-anchored) are invisible internal labels: card text may never reference group membership (F13). Synergy must emerge from visible mechanics (one card enables a condition, another rewards it, another stabilizes the opposite hand) plus a shared naming motif. Combined with per-run rotation and group-unit Steam unlock, this blocks fixed 'solved' combos.
nodes.norm_label: ace group / 군 (synergy group, hidden label)

nodes.label: Lane Branch (RED-/BLUE- archetype prefixes + Enabler/Payoff/Stabilizer)
nodes.rationale: Hand-specific archetypes fork into RED-/BLUE- variants (e.g. RED-EXACT = Redjack set). Mandatory set shape, validated by the Redjack case: Goal → Enabler (lowers the hurdle) → Payoff (rewards the state) → cross-lane Stabilizer (REQUIRED because damage is Red×Blue — a single-lane set is a trap) → optional secondary Payoff completing the loop.

nodes.label: CE/MP System (chip-equivalent strength + group multiplier potential)
nodes.rationale: CE 1.0 = one golden chip = ×1.5 final damage (log scale: CE sums = multiplied multipliers); MP(group) = max CE sum of an optimal ≤5-weight loadout under ideal play. User ruling 2026-06-11: CE/MP bands are gauges and baselines, NOT hard caps — conditional achievement payoffs may exceed them greatly (C04's +5 chips approved: 'it can be much bigger'); explosiveness is controlled by achievement difficulty, not numeric caps. Unconditional/low-condition effects still respect rarity baselines; recording chip_equiv and group MP tables remains mandatory as the input for enemy HP curves (#8).
nodes.norm_label: ce/mp system (chip-equivalent strength + group multiplier potential)

nodes.label: Mission Keyword (M1/M2/M3, ace-bound)
nodes.rationale: Missions attach to the ace card (user, Q15): progress and effect exist only while that ace is equipped. M3 iron rule (F12): permanent growth is linear and applies only inside its condition — Balatro two-pair-joker-style unconditional growth is forbidden.

nodes.label: Redjack Facet Set (RED-EXACT model group)
nodes.rationale: User-designated exemplar for all future sets. Enabler C01 folds a ≤3Wp deficit into the just-hit card (P(Red exactly 21) 16.2% → 59.6% in 100k-run simulation — the goal became a plan); payoff, cross-lane Blue stabilizer and chip payoff convert the achieved Red lane into Blue ambition. Naming: 'Facet' contains 'ace' and means a gem plane cut to exact alignment — red precision.

nodes.label: Bluejack Undertow Set (BLUE-EXACT draft group)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT a mirror of the Redjack set: bluejack via multiples-of-6 effective weight, then rewards EMPTYING the Red hand (value/chips per empty Red slot) — Blue as the waterline baseline, Red striking big with few cards.

nodes.label: Card Generation Track (user ↔ Sonnet workflow)
nodes.rationale: User names an archetype → Sonnet drafts unnamed candidates + simulation (aces_items.md) → user selects survivors → Sonnet names + final YAML (aces_catalog.md). Hard gate: no commits before user approval. Pipeline: card_generation_rules.md (workflow law) → aces.md (approved grammar) → aces_items.md (drafts) → aces_catalog.md (final YAML).

nodes.label: Module Implementation Track (Opus ↔ Codex workflow)
nodes.rationale: Opus writes docs/modules/<module>.md specs and task files; Codex implements on feature/<module> branches and opens PRs into an open review queue; Opus batch-reviews only when the user commands; reviews are on-demand, never automatic.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Top-priority context rule for every agent: query the graph (query/path/explain, GRAPH_REPORT.md) before opening raw files; AST pass is free and run after code changes, semantic pass needs an LLM key. Enforced via PreToolUse/SessionStart hooks and a git post-commit hook.
